rationale.lane: receiver, channel, edge, and actual RF must match exactly
rationale.source: candidate IDs and ranks are ignored; canonical source is original visit, receiver, and probe from the frozen source map
rationale.cfo: 2500 Hz is the deployed tracking residual gate and is applied modulo the lane-normalized alias spacing to same-source measured points
rationale.coverage: a complete conservative association requires at least 80 percent of reference sources
rationale.purity: a complete conservative association requires at least 80 percent of output members whose centers lie in the reference support interval
rationale.curvature: time coverage and overall purity are reported separately; no linear fit field participates in primary eligibility
rationale.segmentation: one-to-one recovery is conservative; multi-reference long arcs and multi-output fragments are reported as merge/split evidence without physical identity claims
